name: mera-news
description: News picked for what you follow, from thousands of publishers in many languages. Mera Labs keeps no copy of your interests. Needs a key from Mera Labs.

api_key.title: News key
api_key.description: For Mera News: the key from Mera Labs (message Mera on WhatsApp or write to contact@mera.news). For your own news server: the key you set on it, or nothing if it runs open.

data_server_url.title: News server address
data_server_url.description: Leave empty to use Mera News. To use a news server you run yourself, give its address, such as http://127.0.0.1:3002. Mera Labs then needs no key from you.

web.title: Also run the Mera News website on this computer
web.description: Shows your news, top stories and profile in your browser, on this computer, and on your phone if you connect it.
